name: morse-monorepo
description: Comfortable Pi Interface — the Pi coding agent in VS Code or in your browser.
author: Supan Adit Pratama

scripts.build: npm run build:libs && npm run build:ui && npm run sync-webview && npm run build:hosts
scripts.build:libs: npm run build -w @morse/protocol && npm run build -w @morse/core && npm run build -w @morse/host-runtime && npm run build -w @morse/adapter-pi-rpc && npm run build -w @morse/ui-runtime
scripts.build:hosts: npm run build:extension && npm run build:server
scripts.build:web: npm run build:libs && npm run build:ui && npm run build -w @supanadit/morse-web
scripts.watch:libs: npm run build:libs && npm run watch -w @morse/ui-runtime
scripts.dev:extension: npm run build:libs && npm run build:ui && npm run sync-webview && npm-run-all -p watch:extension watch:ui watch:webview
scripts.test:fast: npm run test -w @morse/ui-runtime && npm run test -w @morse/ui-angular
scripts.package: npm run build && npm run vsix -w morse
